verdict.rationale: Replica-skill is a set of Claude Code skills that run inside an AI chat. Users invoke stages via slash commands like /replica-backend and /replica-entrepreneur, and can paste a SKILL.md into any chat to run it as a mode. The workflow is conversational, e.g. preflight runs and it 'ships it when you say go'. missing for 10: explicit documentation of free-form natural-language commands beyond slash-command invocation, independent or hands-on corroboration of conversational operation.
